sections.title: Inputs And Signed Draft
sections.text: faces required nonempty array of {name?, point:[x,y,z], normal:[nx,ny,nz]} declared face samples (outward unit normal). pullDirections required nonempty array of {name?, axis:[x,y,z]} or bare [x,y,z] unit pull directions. minDraft optional nonnegative angle default '0 deg'; pullWallWindow default '30 deg'; draftTolerance default '0.1 deg'; method analytic only (native B-Rep ray sampling is gated and rejected). schemaVersion required 1. Signed draft of a face under a pull is 90 deg minus the angle between normal and pull: positive leans toward the pull, negative leans away. A face whose |signedDraft| is within pullWallWindow of parallel is a pull wall and must meet minDraft.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'measure.draft',status,success,documentIdentity,units:{length:'cm',angle:'deg'},frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,draftMap:[{face,pull,signedDraft,signedDraftUnits,normalDotPull,pullWall,drafts,draftViolation}],minDraft,pullWallWindow,draftTolerance,faceCount,pullCount,violationCount,draftViolations,demoldableByDraft,demoldableIsNotDraftAlone:true}. Executor created:[]; read-only. Positive draft alone never proves demoldability.

examples.label: Vertical Wall Versus Pull
examples.requires: Open Design document; one side-wall sample with normal perpendicular to the +Z pull.
examples.output: result.draftMap[0].signedDraft is 0 deg, pullWall is true and draftViolation is true for minDraft 1 deg.

sections.title: Inputs And Material Continuity
sections.text: samples required nonempty array of {name?, point:[x,y,z], opposite?:[x,y,z] | thickness?:length, continuity?:solid|void} wall samples. minThickness default '0 mm'; maxThickness optional. method declared only. schemaVersion required 1. Thickness is |opposite - point| (or the declared thickness). A sample with continuity void is void-backed: the nearest opposite wall is behind a void, so its distance is never reported as material thickness and it is listed under unhandledAreas.

examples.label: Uniform Shell With A Void Behind
examples.requires: Open Design document; one solid 2 mm shell wall and one boss sample whose opposite point is behind a void.
examples.output: result.wallMap[0].thickness is 0.2 cm solid; result.wallMap[1].voidBacked is true and result.unhandledAreas contains 'boss'.

sections.title: Inputs And Directional Undercut
sections.text: faces required nonempty array of declared face samples; pullDirections required nonempty array of unit pull directions; undercutThreshold optional nonnegative angle default '3 deg'. schemaVersion required 1. A face is a directional undercut in a pull when its signed draft is more negative than -undercutThreshold (its normal points back against ejection).

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'undercut.check',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,passed,undercuts:[{face,pull,signedDraft,undercut}],undercutCount,undercutThreshold,demoldable,demoldableIsNotDraftAlone:true}. status is fail when any undercut is found. Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: Lip Against Pull
examples.requires: Open Design document; one lip face with normal pointing back against the +Z pull.
examples.output: result.passed is false, result.undercuts[0].undercut is true and result.undercutCount is 1.

sections.title: Inputs And Zone Definition
sections.text: zones required nonempty array of {name, kind, protected?, pullDirections?, minThickness?, maxThickness?, minDraft?}. kind is a-surface, fit, seal, optical, parting, gate, ejector, weld or custom. protected defaults to true for a-surface/seal/optical. process and material are optional metadata; a missing material produces a warning. sampling optional {method:declared|uniform|adaptive,tolerance?}; uniform/adaptive native sampling is gated. schemaVersion required 1.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'manufacturing.zone',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,zones:[{name,kind,protected,pullDirections}],process,material,sampling,warnings,accuracy}. Executor created:[]; read-only; no native Fusion manufacturing feature is created.

examples.label: Seal And A-Surface Are Protected
examples.requires: Open Design document; two zones without an explicit protected flag.
examples.output: result.zones[0].protected and result.zones[1].protected are both true; result.warnings notes the missing material.

sections.title: Inputs And Aggregation
sections.text: zones, faces, walls and pullDirections required nonempty arrays. minDraft/minThickness/maxThickness/undercutThreshold optional thresholds forwarded to the draft, wall and undercut checks. operations optional array of {name?, touches:[zoneName,...]}: any global operation touching a protected zone (seal/a-surface/optical) is a violation. process/material/sampling optional. schemaVersion required 1. The check composes measure.draft, measure.wall-map and undercut.check through ctx.call.
